usedFor: BigMailer starts the work with “New Contact”, and Google Drive receives it through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in BigMailer, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new contact is a natural moment to hand over a file, and the action makes it reachable by link.

watchOut: “New Contact” in BigMailer is polling, so the share runs after a scheduled check, not the moment the contact appears.
